methods.name: Double/debiased machine learning: PLR (OLS, lasso, ridge learners), IRM (ATE), PLIV, IIVM (LATE) with cross-fitting
methods.reference: An R transcription of DoubleML's published PLR / IRM / PLIV / IIVM scores (Chernozhukov et al. 2018; Bach et al. 2022, 2024) with glmnet/glm learners on fixed folds (DoubleML not installed): dml2, trimming 0.01; learners stats::lm.fit (qr), glmnet::glmnet(lambda = 0.05, standardize = TRUE, thresh = 1e-14) with the exact minimisers of glmnet's objective (*_tight), stats::glm(binomial)
quantities: theta, SE, 95% CI, p-value for PLR (OLS, lasso, ridge), IRM (OLS, lasso outcome learners), PLIV, IIVM, IIVM under one-sided noncompliance
out-of-fold RMSE and R2 per nuisance (l, m, r, g0, g1, r0, r1) and the pooled outcome / treatment diagnostics
score Jacobian -E[psi_a]; mean residualized treatment; trimmed propensity range
fold sizes of the user folds
methods.tolerance: n = 400: OLS and logistic nuisances at validation/README.md (theta 1e-8; SE, RMSE, R2, CI, Jacobian 1e-6 relative); ridge by its closed form against the exact minimiser (*_tight) at the same README tolerances; lasso (coordinate descent at thresh 1e-14) 1e-9 relative to the exact glmnet minimiser (*_tight); lasso and ridge 1e-8 relative to glmnet's own output; p-values 1e-6 relative (no absolute floor); fold sizes exact
